career_ladder.note: Mizoram Civil Service (MCS) and Mizoram Police Service (MPS) are the premier state civil services under the Government of Mizoram, governed by the Mizoram Civil Service Rules and Mizoram Police Service Rules. Direct recruits enter at Junior Grade (Group 'A' Gazetted) under Pay Level 10 of the Mizoram Pay Matrix (Mizoram Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2018) and progress through Senior Grade, Junior Administrative Grade, and Selection Grade, culminating in induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) / Indian Police Service (IPS) AGMUT cadre joint allocation or state supertime scale.

steps.pay_level: Level 10 in the Pay Matrix (₹56,100 - ₹1,24,500, Entry Basic ₹56,100 under Mizoram Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2018)

exam_scheme.note: Governed by the Mizoram Civil Services (Combined Competitive Examination) Rules, 2025 (notified vide Notification No. A.45011/1/2022-P&AR (GSW) dated 16th May, 2025, published in Mizoram Gazette Extraordinary Issue No. 314). The examination is conducted for recruitment to the Junior Grade of MCS, MPS, MF&AS, and MIS across two successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening of 400 marks with 1/3 negative marking penalty; Paper II CSAT qualifying at 33% threshold; Paper I GS merit score determines admission to Mains) and Main Examination (Conventional written descriptive test of 7 papers carrying 250 marks each, where General English is qualifying at 40% threshold, plus 6 merit papers totaling 1,500 marks, followed by a 225-mark Personal Interview, for a grand total of 1,725 merit marks). Optional subjects were eliminated under the 2025 Rules.

stages.source_label: Mizoram Civil Services (Combined Competitive Examination) Rules, 2025 (Schedule-I)

papers.paper_name: Paper-I: General Studies (Current Events of Mizoram, National & International Importance, History of India & National Movement, Indian & World Geography, Indian Polity & Governance, Economic & Social Development, Environmental Ecology & Climate Change, General Science, General Awareness on Mizo Society, Culture & Heritage)
papers.negative_marking: One-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to that question deducted as penalty for each incorrect response
papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit score in Paper I determines qualification for admission to Main Examination shortlist (~10 times the number of vacancies; subject to minimum 33% in Paper II)

papers.paper_name: Paper-II: Aptitude Tests (CSAT — English Language Comprehension Skills Class X, Interpersonal Skills including Communication, Logical Reasoning & Analytical Ability, Decision Making & Problem Solving, General Mental Ability, Basic Numeracy & Data Interpretation Class X)
papers.negative_marking: One-third (0.33) of the marks assigned to that question deducted as penalty for each incorrect response
papers.qualifying_threshold: 33% (minimum 66 marks out of 200 required to qualify)

stages.source_label: Mizoram Civil Services (Combined Competitive Examination) Rules, 2025 (Rule 9(2) & Rule 10)

papers.paper_name: Paper 1: General English (Comprehension of Given Passages, Précis Writing, Usage & Vocabulary, Short Essays, Letter Writing — Matriculation or Equivalent Standard)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% (minimum 100 marks out of 250 required to qualify; marks not counted for final merit order)

papers.paper_name: Paper 2: General Essay (Multiple Essay Topics requiring Orderly Presentation, Concise Expression and Effective Articulation)
Paper 3: General Studies-I (Indian Heritage and Culture, History and Geography of the World and Society)
Paper 4: General Studies-II (Governance, Constitution, Polity, Social Justice and International Relations)
Paper 5: General Studies-III (Technology, Economic Development, Biodiversity, Environment, Security and Disaster Management)

Paper 6: General Studies-IV (Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude — Human Values, Attitude, Foundational Values for Civil Services, Emotional Intelligence, Moral Thinkers, Probity in Governance, Case Studies)

Paper 7: General Studies-V (General Subject Paper on Mizoram — Mizo History, Heritage, Culture & Social Structure; Geography, Climate, Minerals & Tourism of Mizoram; State Secretariat, District Administration & Autonomous District Councils; Governance, Education & Health Programmes; State Economy, Act East Policy, Budget, PSUs & Land Revenue System)

stages.source_label: Mizoram Civil Services (Combined Competitive Examination) Rules, 2025 (Rule 9(2)(e) & Schedule-IV)

papers.paper_name: Personal Interview / Personality Test (Assessment of Mental Calibre, Critical Powers of Assimilation, Clear & Logical Exposition, Balance of Judgement, Variety & Depth of Interest, Leadership, Intellectual & Moral Integrity)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Awarded marks must be between 30% (minimum 67.5 marks) and 90% (maximum 202.5 marks); multiplier is twice the number of vacant posts for 10 or more posts

financial_package.note: Direct recruitment to the Junior Grade of MCS, MPS, MF&AS, and MIS is made at Pay Matrix Level 10 (₹56,100 - ₹1,24,500) with entry basic pay of ₹56,100 under the Mizoram Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2018 (corresponding to pre-revised PB-3 ₹15,600 - ₹39,100 + Grade Pay ₹5,400 under Mizoram ROP 2010).
financial_package.pay_level: Level 10 in the Pay Matrix (₹56,100 - ₹1,24,500; old PB-3 ₹15,600 - ₹39,100 + GP ₹5,400 under Mizoram ROP 2010/2018)
financial_package.pay_source_label: MPSC Advt. No. 1 of 2025-26 & Mizoram Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2018
financial_package.estimate_note: Estimated based on Mizoram Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹56,100 at project standard 58% Dearness Allowance (effective 1 Jul 2025) plus House Rent Allowance (10% in Aizawl state capital municipal area, 8% or 7% in other district headquarters and rural sub-divisions), fixed medical allowance (₹1,000/month), and special hill area allowances where admissible; net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS, 10% on Basic + DA = ₹8,864/month), Professional Tax (₹200/month), and Mizoram State Employees Group Insurance Scheme (GIS).
official_perks: Designated government residential accommodation / official quarters as per district entitlement
Official government vehicle with driver for SDO, Assistant Commissioner, and DSP executive field duties
Armed personal security / police escort for SDM and DSP executive postings in sensitive subdivisions
Medical reimbursement facilities under the Mizoram Medical Attendance Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment benefits as per Mizoram State Service Rules
Special Compensatory / Hill Area Allowance when posted in designated hill district headquarters
